raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE pa.date <= '2015-09-21'
AND pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    AND pa2.date <= '2015-09-21'
);
```
